mapper.insert: INSERT INTO social_location_jobs ( id, user_id, source_url, source_key, platform, status, python_job_id, language, user_tier, video_duration_seconds, max_duration_seconds, request_payload, result_payload, error_code, error_message, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, deadline_at, last_heartbeat_at, last_reconciled_at, failure_stage, error_details, created_at, started_at, completed_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceKey}, #{platform}, #{status, javaType=com.ds.goroute.type.SocialLocationJobStatus}, #{pythonJobId}, #{language}, #{userTier}, #{videoDurationSeconds}, #{maxDurationSeconds}, #{requestPayload}, #{resultPayload}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{deadlineAt}, #{lastHeartbeatAt}, #{lastReconciledAt}, #{failureStage}, CAST(#{errorDetails,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE social_location_jobs SET source_url = #{sourceUrl}, source_key = #{sourceKey}, platform = #{platform}, status = #{status, javaType=com.ds.goroute.type.SocialLocationJobStatus}, python_job_id = #{pythonJobId}, language = #{language}, user_tier = #{userTier}, video_duration_seconds = #{videoDurationSeconds}, max_duration_seconds = #{maxDurationSeconds}, request_payload = #{requestPayload}, result_payload = #{resultPayload}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, deadline_at = #{deadlineAt}, last_heartbeat_at = #{lastHeartbeatAt}, last_reconciled_at = #{lastReconciledAt}, failure_stage = #{failureStage}, error_details = CAST(#{errorDetails,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE social_location_jobs SET status = #{job.status, javaType=com.ds.goroute.type.SocialLocationJobStatus}, python_job_id = #{job.pythonJobId}, error_code = #{job.errorCode}, error_message = #{job.errorMessage}, error_details = CAST(#{job.errorDetails,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), failure_stage = #{job.failureStage}, next_attempt_at = #{job.nextAttemptAt}, deadline_at = #{job.deadlineAt}, last_heartbeat_at = #{job.lastHeartbeatAt}, last_reconciled_at = #{job.lastReconciledAt}, started_at = #{job.startedAt}, completed_at = #{job.completedAt}, updated_at = #{job.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{job.id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM social_location_jobs WHERE python_job_id = #{pythonJobId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM social_location_jobs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND result_payload IS NOT NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(completed_at, created_at) DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM social_location_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND result_payload IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM social_location_jobs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM social_location_jobs WHERE status = 'QUEUED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM social_location_jobs WHERE status IN ('DISPATCHING', 'PROCESSING') AND (deadline_at IS NULL OR deadline_at > NOW())

SELECT * FROM social_location_jobs WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND (last_reconciled_at IS NULL OR last_reconciled_at <= #{reconcileBefore}) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_reconciled_at, started_at, updated_at) LIMIT #{limit}

WITH claimed AS ( SELECT id FROM social_location_jobs WHERE status = 'QUEUED' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE social_location_jobs job SET status = 'DISPATCHING', attempt_count = COALESCE(job.attempt_count, 0) + 1, next_attempt_at = NULL, failure_stage = NULL, updated_at = NOW() FROM claimed WHERE job.id = claimed.id RETURNING job.*
